facts.text: The package registers social-nav-train-env-v0 with kwargs test=False and social-nav-test-env-v0 with kwargs test=True; both use the entry point gym_social_navigation.envs:SocialNavEnv
The environment uses data from the ETH Pedestrian dataset
The test flag selects the data/val files; otherwise the data/train files are used
The robot keeps 3 previous states per agent, tracks at most 4 agents within a 10-unit proximity radius, uses 4 path points and requires a normalised start-goal distance of at least 0.45
The maximum robot velocity is 0.75 m/s, velocity is discretised by 0.25 m/s and the fixed steering angle is 30 degrees
The dataset timestep is 0.4 s and the episode time is divided by it to give the step limit
The observation space is a Box of 3 + 2*num_agents*(agent_hist+1) + 2*num_path_points values with low 0 and high 1
The action list has three left actions, four straight actions (including speed 0) and three right actions; the action space is Discrete(len(actions))
The reward weights are alpha 3.5 for the change in path distance and beta 5 for the change in goal distance; the goal reward is 10, the collision penalty 20 and the out-of-bounds penalty 15
The goal threshold is 0.05 and the collision distance is 0.30
A reset picks a random dataset, a random start time and a random start and goal position
Step moves the pose with the fixed steering angle and timestep, then computes the reward from the change in goal distance and path distance
A collision ends the episode with -collision_penalty, reaching the goal with goal_reward, the time limit with the current reward and leaving the unit square with -out_of_bounds_penalty
The observation and action spaces are gym.spaces.Box and gym.spaces.Discrete

determinism.notes: the fake's reset(seed=...) repeats its synthetic start, goal and pedestrian trace; upstream SocialNavEnv.reset() takes no seed and draws from numpy's global generator, so the sim backend is not seeded by cap.world.seed.v1 (it only records the seed for the next reset)

gaps: kinematic model only: the robot pose moves directly from the action with the fixed steering angle and the pedestrians follow a canned trace; there are no contacts, friction, actuator, sensor or noise dynamics
the pedestrian trace in the fake is synthetic test data with two agents, not the ETH Pedestrian dataset (README.md:3) the clone loads; the real trace is not modelled
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0, ticks advance simulated time by timestep_ms (0.4 s) only
the fake reproduces the 43-value observation layout, but its start and goal are drawn from a narrow safe band instead of the clone's full unit square, and no rendering was run
the driver sets autoreset=True: a step after a terminal state resets the world and starts a new episode, whereas upstream SocialNavEnv requires an explicit reset() and keeps the terminal state
upstream reset() takes no seed or options (social_nav_env.py:186), so the fake's seed/options parameters and the bridge's seed control do not exist on the upstream environment
snapshot and restore are not offered: the environment exposes no get_state or set_state

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the environment state is kept and stays readable
